description.subtitle: Puma Milan Sports Backpack - Black
description.tagline: Lleva tu estilo rossonero a todas partes
description.intro: The Puma Milan Essentials backpack is the ideal option for those who live football beyond the field. Its modern and resistant design offers you the perfect space to carry everything you need, without giving up your fan identity.
key_benefits: Intelligent distribution: Spaces designed so that each object has its place.
Functional style: Sober and elegant design that combines with any urban or sports outfit.
Guaranteed comfort: Padded adjustable straps for more comfortable carrying.
Rossonera identity: Inspired by the official Milan 25/26 kit.
Suitable for everyday use: Ideal for going to class, training or moving around the city.
